sourceNotes.rawContent: Radiate elegance with our signature Tennis Bracelet. Featuring a seamless line of brilliant shimmering crystals, this high-fashion statement piece adds instant luxury to any outfit. To preserve its radiant silver-toned luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it in a dry place after every wear.
